messages:
sophia: Quick company update — Hosted API: Tooling + Streaming is GA as of today. :tada:

sophia: What’s included: streaming tool-calls (SSE + SDK helpers), structured function outputs, a new model family (Cascade-13B) tuned for interactive tool use, and an updated default quota policy (small behaviour change — see below). Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/tooling-ga

sophia: Migration notes: endpoints remain backward-compatible. New opt-in flag for existing orgs `enable_tooling=true`. New orgs created after rollout will have tooling enabled by default for hosted. After a 2 week opt-in window we’ll enable by default for all hosted accounts to avoid fragmentation. Dedicated/Private customers — will not auto-enable; contact your SE to schedule the upgrade.

sophia: Quick curl example (streaming tool-calls):
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"model":"cascade-13b","input":"fetch latest invoice","tooling":{"enabled":true}}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate/stream
```

sophia: If you run proxies or API gateways, make sure they allow streaming (SSE) and keep-alive. Also note: we tightened a few API quotas to prevent noisy-tool abuse — you can view limits in the Console and request increases via support.

matt: Awesome — congrats team. Do the python/js SDKs already support streaming tool-calls? Any breaking changes we should be careful about?

sophia: Yes — SDK releases 0.7.2 (py) and 1.3.0 (js) include helpers for streaming + function invocation helpers. No breaking changes to existing call shapes; we added new optional helpers and params. Release notes: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/releases/0.7.2

ana: (ana): Performance question — how does Cascade-13B compare vs the standard 13B we had? latency / cost / accuracy tradeoffs?

sophia: Cascade-13B is optimized for interactive tool loops: roughly similar generation quality, ~1.6–1.9x lower tail latency in short-response scenarios and ~2.2x better token-cost when paired with our default quantization profile. We’ve published microbenchmarks in the perf section of the docs. If you have specific workloads send sample prompts and we’ll run a profile.

remi: We’ll prep a short 1-pager and a couple of sample notebooks for customers and workspaces this week. @liz can we coordinate an announcement to active users and the blog? :email:

liz: Yep — I’ll draft a short customer-facing note and coordinate with Growth. Will share in #marketing-drafts for review.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Hosted-tooling-prod v1.0 rolled out to 12 regions (us-west-2, us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1, etc.). Canary checks passed.

matt: One more quick ask — is there a migration checklist for infra teams (rate-limit changes / headers / SSE tuning)?

sophia: Yes — added a short checklist in the docs under "Migration & Ops". If your infra needs custom tuning ping #eng-infra or @matt and we’ll queue a consult.

sophia: Thanks everyone — please report any regressions to support and file feedback via the internal form: https://redwood.ai/internal/tooling-feedback
